title: Example 151: Crosscut retry throttle, a regression proof over an object made by its constructor (own checker)
description: Runs example 151 through build.py: a B9 regression proof by jvmcontract's own checker of Crosscut's RetryThrottling, whose Throttle parameter is made in the harness by its constructor from symbolic limits (step H2-H4 of llm-dlc/loops/foundations-heap.md). 150 is a correct rewrite of recorded, 151 the alias-to-copy defect in reconfigured, 152 a rewrite of recorded wrong only on drained throttles, which the constructor never makes. Checked inline on the same classes before submitting; the job records result.json and the page.
expected: violation: reconfigured(throttle=new Throttle(new ThrottleLimits(1, 1)), limits=ThrottleLimits[maxTokens=1, tokenRatioMilli=1]), the replays equal in every field and differing only in result == throttle, replayed in the interpreter and run on a JVM; existing tests passing
